props.name: entity_type
props.meaning: Type the editor reads its fields on.

props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Every read goes through it, so widgets on a page share one cache.

props.name: value
props.meaning: The applied tree. Two-way in Svelte through `bind:value`.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the dialog is showing. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Launcher heights 7, 8 and 9. Passed to the editor inside.

events.name: changed
events.when: The tree was applied, by Apply, Clear all or the clear control, never while editing. Svelte also binds it with `bind:value`.

events.name: open_changed
events.when: The dialog opened or closed. Svelte also binds it with `bind:open`.

slots.name: fieldChooser
slots.draws: The field chooser, in place of FieldPicker.

slots.name: valueEditor
slots.draws: Every value control in the editor.

slots.name: entityEditor
slots.receives: the same arguments as the value editor

keyboard.does: Opens the dialog from the launcher.
Cycles inside the dialog while it is open.
Closes the dialog and drops the staged edits.
